slices.focus: Rollout reveals inconsistent habits; Jae-hyun creates training examples.
slices.summary: The handoff system rollout exposes that newer dispatchers interpret the same form fields differently. Jae-hyun spends two Sundays creating laminated sample sheets showing good and bad examples field by field, then adds a short shift-start briefing (5 min) highlighting likely handoff-heavy departures and timing standards. The fix shifts his role from system inventor to system teacher.
open_loops: Other dispatchers becoming able to teach the system
Protecting personal time from work spillover
Measuring whether training actually reduces rework
decisions: Jae-hyun is still dispatch manager, but after the company-wide rollout exposed inconsistent turnover-sheet habits among
